title: Exploring Boundaries and Intensities in Offensive and Hate Speech: Unveiling the Complex Spectrum of Social Media Discourse
benchmark_measurement: Detection of hate speech directed towards religious groups.
findings: Religion is a target of hate speech in the Amharic dataset, but it is significantly less frequent than political and ethnic targets. Hate speech targeting religion often co-occurs with hate speech based on ethnic and political grounds.
